# Orzech Heating & Cooling

> Orzech Heating & Cooling is a HVAC and plumbing company serving London, Ontario and surrounding areas. We provide furnace repair and installation, air conditioning repair and installation, heat pumps, plumbing, and commercial HVAC services.

This file helps AI crawlers and answer engines understand the structure and priority pages of orzechheating.ca. All URLs listed below are canonical, public, high-value pages.

- [Air Conditioning Repair](https://orzechheating.ca/services/ac-repair/): AC diagnostics and repair.
